facts: addNewEntity delegates addEntity with the legacy-loading flag false.
addEntity posts the synchronous cancellable EntityJoinLevelEvent; cancellation returns false before insertion.
addEntityWithoutEvent rejects duplicate UUIDs; otherwise it inserts into entity sections, installs callbacks, performs visibility-related callbacks and returns true.
Join and lifecycle callbacks may mutate state or reenter machine code before the enclosing ServerLevel.addFreshEntity returns.
